steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); })()

steps.name: place-blinds
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([ { id: 'zebra1', defId: 'roller-blind', position: [1.2, 2.7], rotation: 0, props: { kind: 'zebra', lower: 1, width: 1.3, drop: 1.7, color: '#d8d2c4' } }, { id: 'roman1', defId: 'roller-blind', position: [3.4, 2.7], rotation: 0, props: { kind: 'roman', lower: 1, width: 1.3, drop: 1.7, color: '#c9a878' } } ]); })()

steps.name: set-window-invisible-grille
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const win=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='window'); if (win) window.__store.getState().updateOpening(win.id,{style:'invisible-grille'}); return win ? win.id : null; })()

steps.name: set-door-bifold
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); if (door) window.__store.getState().updateOpening(door.id,{style:'bifold'}); return door ? door.id : null; })()

steps.name: door-open
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door' && o.style==='bifold'); if (door) window.__store.getState().toggleDoor(door.id); return door ? door.id : null; })()
